words.prose: {{ar:أَلَّا}} ({{tr:ʾallā}}) makes the ayah begin in dependence rather than independence: it looks back to the balance being set in 55:7 and turns the current words into the purpose, that transgression not occur. words.prose: {{ar:تَطْغَوْا۟}} ({{tr:taṭghaw}}) is the verb where the cosmic report becomes direct accountability: the plural ending brings the addressees into the clause, while the dropped mood marker shows dependence on {{ar:أَلَّا}} ({{tr:ʾallā}}). Its Form I shape keeps the crossing with the addressed group itself rather than shifting causation outward, and its root image makes excess feel like overflow past a boundary; the balance phrase narrows that force to transgression within a measured order. The same constructional shape is illuminated by 20:81, and the contrast with 96:6 shows how a diagnosis of human overreach can become here a preventive purpose. The prefix-vowel variant and rough consonant texture add recitational color without changing the subject, mood, or domain.

words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) is the small hinge that keeps the prohibition domain-specific. It does not make the balance merely an instrument used for transgressing; it places overstepping within or with respect to the balance-domain, under the negation opened by {{ar:أَلَّا}} ({{tr:ʾallā}}). Because the preposition can carry both location and concern, it allows the physical scale, the act of measuring, and the broader order of balance to overlap without collapsing them. As a free preposition joined in recitation to the final noun, it gives the balance-domain its own heard phrase before closure.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمِيزَانِ}} ({{tr:al-mīzāni}}) is the word the ayah lands on. Its definiteness points back to the balance just set in 55:7, while its genitive case after {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) changes that balance from placed object into the domain where humans must not overstep. The weak-initial weighing root is smoothed into an instrument noun, keeping the image concrete: a scale or criterion by which proportion is known, not merely the act of weighing or the thing weighed. 55:9 pulls the same field forward into establishing weight with equity, and wider weighing scenes in 7:8 and 21:47 support the justice field without replacing the local 55:7-9 sequence. Thus the word carries cosmic order, practical measurement, evaluative justice, and final acoustic weight together, without reducing the local phrase to only one of them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction joins the prohibited motion of tatghaw to al-mizan as the domain in which that motion occurs.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verb supplies movement past a proper limit, while the balance supplies a justice-bearing standard. The command therefore blocks an agent from crossing the equitable bound made operative by measurement.

activation_trace.role: Overstepping a proper bound supplies the prohibited motion and makes the violation directional rather than merely inaccurate.
The justice-bearing scale supplies the normative limit against which the overstep is detected.

changed_reading.before: Do not commit an unspecified excess around a scale.
changed_reading.after: Do not cross the just limit that the balance makes operative.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same root pair can couple a rising, overwhelming force with a balance that aligns terms against one another.
baseline_models.mechanism: An initial displacement can become a surge that erases the counterrelation needed for balance. The prohibition addresses runaway amplification, not only a single fraudulent act.

activation_trace.role: Overflowing force supplies a dynamic failure mode in which excess rises until it overwhelms its container or counterpart.
Alignment between two things supplies the relation that runaway force would destroy.

changed_reading.before: The command regulates deliberate cheating at a weighing event.
changed_reading.after: It also blocks runaway force that overwhelms a calibrated relation, even when the first displacement was small.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Tatghaw marks departure beyond a limit, while al-mizan can name aligned and proportioned created terms.
baseline_models.mechanism: Balance is not flat sameness. It is a relation among differently proportioned terms, and transgression occurs when one term is forced beyond the relation that lets the whole remain coherent.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant mapped root still supplies a clear act of exceeding the assigned limit.
Balancing or aligning counterparts makes the operative unit a relation rather than an isolated quantity.
Measured created proportion extends the relation from an instrument to the constitution of things.

changed_reading.before: Balance requires making all sides equal in amount.

strongest_changes: 55:9 revises a one-sided excess model into active calibration against both overreach and shortfall.
55:19-22 changes static balance into a permeable boundary that permits contact and emergence without domination.
55:31-41 extends weight from objects to agents, acquired conduct, visible evidence, and accountability.
55:66 weakens the claim that strong flow is inherently transgressive by showing abundant force within a paired, positive setting.
summary.what_was_special: The split TGHY mapping kept several readings alive at once: ordinary limit-crossing, hydraulic runaway, institutional capture, and contained noise or fragment outliers. Context then activated cosmological, commercial, ecological, legal, reciprocal, and rhetorical mechanisms without forcing them into one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet sequences strongly invite causal models, but several sequences may be juxtaposed signs rather than explanations of al-mizan.
The sea and garden structures may instantiate balance, or they may function only as analogies discovered by the reader.
The authority reading depends on extending the sultan challenge into a general test of warrant.
The noise, temporal-midpoint, and detached-fragment readings remain deliberately form-distant and require explicit qualification.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Moral excess pictured as overflow.** `ط غ ي/B001` gives overstepping a bound in rebellion, while `ط غ ي/B002` supplies rising water that overwhelms. The two seas held from transgression in 55:19–20 activate the material variant. I infer an analogy between social excess and fluid overflow. The command reads as preventing one's force from flooding the relation calibrated by the balance.
2. **Do not convert alignment into domination.** `و ز ن/B003` makes the balance an alignment of two things. Combined with `ط غ ي/B001`, I infer that transgression occurs when one side exceeds its relational limit. The warning therefore reads against domination, not only inaccurate weighing.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 55:33–35 turns attempted boundary-penetration into an image of failed excess. It reveals that “in the balance” reaches beyond commerce to any effort to cross an assigned limit without warrant.

Assigned role: overstepping names agent-caused displacement inside a prior alignment. Packet evidence is the clause linkage and repeated balance lexemes; inference: the installed order creates a boundary that human action can either preserve or violate. identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu adı, inatçı ve kendini büyük gören; yaptıklarını umursamadan insanları yiyip bitirircesine ezen hükümdar veya zorba için verir. Geçici çerçeve kişi türünü ve baskıcı davranışı doğru biçimde sınırlar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, sözlükleşmiş kişi adını yalın dal olarak korur ve aynı biçimin felaket anlamını bu dala taşımaz.

concept_map.definition: İnsanları ezen, yaptığı kötülüğü umursamayan, inatçı, kendini büyük gören zalim hükümdar ya da zorbaya verilen addır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Buradaki ölçü yaratılış ve var edilme bağlamına bağlıdır; komşu dal uygun miktar, orta boy ve beden oranı gibi daha geniş kullanımlara sahiptir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal, yaratılmış şeyin ölçülü ve dengeli olma niteliğini öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal, bir varlığın yaratılış biçimini ve beden yapısını anlatırken buluşabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda uygun ölçü ve denge kurucudur; komşuda ise parçalı yapı ve kuruluş biçimi kurucudur.

channel_review.note: first-pass blind review by a single reader; no adjudication, no accept/reject, no per-ayah channel maturity. Not a channel ledger.

full_context_packet.note: surah-scope fallback: the default commentary workflow does not consume per-ayah focus packets, so the source packet is scoped by this builder to roots this ayah can justify and carries no staged reveal order

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

v12_cross_run_publication.note: Compact final cross-run findings for this ayah, reconciled upstream from regular and plus/minus-5 reader runs; use as a coverage/priority check, not as replacement prose.
